# Overview
Relationship type between `OTC derivative instrument` and `OTC derivative as a hedge` has cardinality 'one-to-many' but the primary key of the target and source entity types is equal
### Contact person
dominik.lin-ully@oenb.at
### Background information _[info]_
### Points/Questions to resolve
If there exists a 'one-to-many' relationship type between two entity types (e.g., 'source' and 'target') the 'target' entity type's primary key must be 'larger' than the 'source' primary key.
This is not the case for the entity types `OTC derivative instrument` and `OTC derivative as a hedge`, although the relationship type's cardinality is 'one-to-many'.
